evidence.quote: Normal duration 7 Semester Language English ECTS 210
Teaching language English Languages All courses are held in English.

All applicants who obtained their school-leaving certificate outside Germany (foreign students) need to have their certificates preliminarily assessed by Uni-Assist when applying to the University of Applied Sciences

All applicants who obtained their school-leaving certificate outside Germany (foreign students) need to have their certificates preliminarily assessed by Uni-Assist when applying to the University of Applied Sciences
Required documents:  University entrance qualification  Pre-assessment documentation „uni-assist“
Applicants must demonstrate English language proficiency at a minimum level of B2 (CEFR) through appropriate certificates or other recognised proof.

note.fr: Une qualification d'entrée à l'université (Fachhochschulreife ou Hochschulreife) est exigée ; les candidats titulaires d'un certificat de maître artisan peuvent aussi être éligibles sous certaines conditions.
note.en: A university entrance qualification (Fachhochschulreife or Hochschulreife) is required; applicants with a master craftsman's certificate may also be eligible under certain conditions.

evidence.quote: Professionally qualified applicants (for example, those holding a master craftsman certificate (Meisterbrief)) may also apply for admission under certain conditions.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page says "Tuition fees per semester None"; only the student union fee of 125.62 EUR must be transferred. Duration: 7 semesters / 210 ECTS = 3.5 years. Application deadline: the DAAD page gives "15 April - 15 July" for applicants from all countries but without a year, and the university's international-applicants page gives only "Mid-April - mid-July"; no dated deadline could be quoted. Application channel: the university's own portal is used, but foreign certificates must first be reviewed by uni-assist (VPD), hence de-uni-assist-vpd.
